alerts.title: Abdominal pain may indicate TDF toxicity
alerts.message: Guidelines list abdominal pain or discomfort and decreased appetite among major adverse events of TDF, alongside chronic kidney disease, Fanconi syndrome, and lactic acidosis; recommended workup is LFTs and RFTs. Patient reports abdominal pain without fever while on TDF-containing TLD since March 2023. Appetite is preserved and no fever is present, which argues against severe toxicity or infection. However, TDF toxicity can occur late after months or years of treatment, so drug attribution cannot be excluded. Latest creatinine (82 umol/L, 78 days ago) is reassuring but does not rule out hepatic or other TDF-related injury.

evidence.recommended_action: Perform LFTs and RFTs to evaluate TDF-related toxicity; grade the symptom per ADR severity criteria and screen for other causes of abdominal pain.

alerts.title: Plan lacks laboratory workup for suspected ADR
alerts.message: Guidelines require baseline and routine laboratory investigations plus clinical screening for any suspected adverse drug event. The clinician's plan today documents the abdominal pain complaint but contains no orders, no medicine changes, and no laboratory investigations. This leaves a potential TDF adverse drug reaction uninvestigated. The patient's stable viral suppression (25 copies/mL) and normal creatinine do not substitute for the required ADR evaluation.

evidence.recommended_action: Add clinical ADR screening and indicated laboratory investigations (LFTs, RFTs) to today's plan per suspected adverse drug event guidelines.

alerts.title: TDF renal monitoring interval may be overdue
alerts.message: Guidelines specify serum creatinine and eGFR monitoring for patients on a TDF-based backbone. The only creatinine on record is 82 umol/L from 2025-11-05, 78 days before this visit, and no eGFR is documented. With a new abdominal pain symptom that guidelines link to TDF renal and metabolic toxicity, current renal function should be confirmed rather than relying on a value nearly three months old.

evidence.recommended_action: Repeat serum creatinine and calculate eGFR today, particularly given the new abdominal pain symptom on TDF.
